items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: This boy's name. Is Lester Collies... And this is Lester Collies... So it reads Milton Baptiste. Andrew Jefferson. Andy Anderson. David Grillier. Lester Collies.

ctx.x: Who is. Who they have on here. Do they have any.
Yeah. Well number one. It's me in the back. That's me. In the back. Andrew Jefferson. This boy's name. This boy's name. Is Lester Collies. His name is Edwards. He happens to be.
Going from left. From left to right.
